bias.zh: 回调 · 失守 $176.8，在 $165 获得支撑反弹

read.en: Palantir fell 1.6% on Nov 3 to $175.40, trading between $165.25 and $176.54 on 2.2 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($186.2) and 10-day ($192.3) and the rising 30-day ($193.8), and above the rising 100-day ($163.4) and 200-day ($153.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($199.89), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: Palantir 11月3日下跌 1.6%，收于 $175.40，盘中区间 $165.25–176.54，成交量为 20 日均量的 2.2 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$186.2）和 10 日均线（$192.3）以及上行的 30 日均线（$193.8）下方，并位于上行的 100 日（$163.4）和 200 日均线（$153.6）上方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$199.89），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The $176.8 Sep 21 low broke, now resistance, but the drop to $165.25 held the Sep 10 low and 100-day, and the close recovered near the high. Resistance is $176.5–176.8, then $180.8–182 and $184.5–187.6 (Oct 16 low, 5-day, Nov 2 high). Support is $163.4–165.3 (100-day, Sep 10 and Nov 3 lows), then $158.3 and $152.7–153.6. A close above $182 would target $186–187.5; below $163.4, $158.
